description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5320014141459 RIVET,BLIND: Line 0001 Qty 3369 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0147 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
